reason: The free app already gives me 3 questions a day, which is more than I would ever need for two dishes, and for anything else I just watch a TikTok clip or ask my mum on LINE. Paying 99 baht a month only to ask more questions makes no sense for me.
objection: Only two dishes? I would run out after two dinners, and then I am paying 99 baht a month for nothing.
would_change_my_mind: A membership that unlocks dozens of everyday Thai dishes, not just more questions, for around 49 baht a month.
